title: hibbertia billardierei var. scabra
intro: Hibbertia billardierei var. scabra, commonly known as the Scabrous Guinea Flower, is a plant species in the Dilleniaceae family. It is a small shrub native to Australia, valued for its medicinal properties and traditional use by Indigenous Australians. The health benefits of Hibbertia billardierei var. scabra include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, have been identified as contributing to its therapeutic properties.
